path.description: Mega-MoE kernel (dispatch + grouped GEMM + combine in one persistent kernel): per-expert token counts and slot tickets in shared memory (atomicAdd_block, sm100_bf16_mega_moe.cuh:319 and 335), cross-rank send/recv counts (atomic_add / atomic_add_sys at 328, 363), ring-buffer full/empty counters (red_add_rel at 543, red_add_rel / red_add at 1009-1026) and integer receive statistics (red_add at 591). The fp8/fp4 twin has the same structure (sm100_fp8_fp4_mega_moe.cuh:361-1202; DeepGEMM-0010).

downstream.argument: The tickets decide only where a token-topk pair lands in an expert's pool. Each pool row is computed on its own: the SwiGLU and routing weight are applied per row (sm100_bf16_mega_moe.cuh:935-963), the L2 result is written back to a buffer addressed by (source rank, token, top-k slot) from the row's metadata (1114-1129), and the combine sums a token's top-k slots in ascending slot order (__ffs at 1229-1230) in fp32 registers (1250-1269) before one bf16 cast. Arrival order therefore changes which CTA and pool row compute a contribution, not the order of the final sum.
